column1: # Names of Slovenian places and regions with their accents, from the entries of
# Slovenski pravopis 2001 (ZRC SAZU, on Fran.si) for the settlements, municipalities,
# regions, rivers and mountains of GeoNames (SI); read by tools/formant/slovenian_words.py,
# which declines them into the tables of names (formant_slovenian.inc).
# Columns: name; headword with its accents; genitive as SP writes it (an ending
# replacing the end of the word from its first letter, or the whole form; one per
# word, ~ for a word that does not change); gender (m, ž, s) and number (mn.);
# forms the entry names besides (na Gorenjskem); words that SP accents otherwise
# in another entry (Cerkljè na Gorenjskem, Cérklje ob Krki; the surname
# Léskovec, Leskôvec pri Krškem), which are left to the lexicon.
